translation: Yehoshua akamuka mangwananaga, ndokubva pakambamhini yeShitimu; ndokufika kune Yaridheni, iye navana vomadzinza ose vaIsraeri; vakagara kunze kuri ipapo, usati wapo wavhuka. — kudarika: Yehoshua akamuka mangwananaga, uye vakabuda kuShitimu, ndokusvika paYaridheni, iye nevanhu vose vevaIsraeri; vakavhika ipapo, usatiwavhuka. — kupedzisira: Yehoshua akamuka mangwanananga, vakafamba kubva kuShitimu, ndokufika paYaridheni, iye nevazhinji vose vevaIsraeri, vakazorora ipapo, vasati vavhuka.
